name: 老人库人数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM PC_OldPeople

name: 签约人数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM PC_SignedOldPeople

name: 护理级别分布
aliases: 护理级别分别有多少人
sql: SELECT Nursinglevel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM PC_OldPeople GROUP BY Nursinglevel

name: 突发事件场次
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM Cultivate_Examination

name: 分组人数
sql: SELECT g.Name AS group_name, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM PC_PersonGroup g JOIN PC_PersonGroupItem i ON g.PersonGroupId = i.PersonGroupId GROUP BY g.PersonGroupId, g.Name
